slides.title: Walking backward
slides.subtitle: Why the fruits of the past come sooner

slides.label: Rule 13
slides.title:
The past comes
back sooner
body: When a graha walks backward, the fruits of past actions come quickly.

slides.label: What backward means
slides.title: A trick of the view
body: Seen from Earth, a graha now and then slows, stops and seems to walk back through the signs.

slides.label: A picture for it
slides.title: Looking back
body: Someone walking home looks back, sees a person in trouble, and turns round to help. Walking backward is that turn.

slides.label: In the sky now
slides.title:
The auditor
walks back
body: Saturn has walked backward in Pisces since late July. It turns forward on Thursday 10 December, about 8 PM.
slides.closing: Old work comes back for a second look

slides.label: Nadi Jyotisha · chapter 4
slides.title: Who walks back
items: Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn
Jupiter on 12 December, Mars on 10 January

slides.label: In your chart
slides.title:
An R beside
a graha
body: A graha marked R in your birth chart was walking backward when you were born. By this rule its fruits come sooner.
